_meta.purpose: Map a normalised citation cue to its canonical work_id, for the new corpora (Homer/Pindar/NT) the resolver must route. Chains into nt_chapter_lengths.json: an NT cue -> book name -> verses-per-chapter.
_meta.normalisation: Look up by norm(cue): lower-cased, accent-stripped, trailing-period-stripped, internal whitespace collapsed to one space. For NT, convert a Roman letter-number to Arabic FIRST (I->1, II->2), so 'II Cor.' -> '2 cor'. The Homer/Pindar expanders already emit canonical cues (Il/Od, Ol/Pyth/Nem/Isth), so those keys match directly.
_meta.scope: homer: Iliad/Odyssey. pindar: the four ode collections as works. nt: the 13-letter Pauline corpus (keys match nt_chapter_lengths.json books).
